text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. During the sprint, team members hold daily standups — brief meetings to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver working products quickly, gather feedback, and improve continuously. Agile helps teams stay flexible and respond to changes more easily.
